CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Zirvenin hızlı başladığını ve Limak Holding olarak geniş bir ekiple etkinlikte yer aldıklarını belirten Özdemir, ilk büyük panellerinin "She Leads" başlıklı etkinlik olduğunu ifade etti. Kadınların karar verici pozisyonlarda daha fazla yer almasını hedefleyen panelde dünyanın farklı ülkelerinden bakanlar, sivil toplum kuruluşu başkanları ve üniversite rektörlerinin bir araya geldiğini aktaran Özdemir, "Yani çünkü biz artık kadınlar olarak katılmayı değil aynı zamanda karar verici masalarda karar veren de olmayı istiyoruz. Çünkü iklim çok önemli bir konu, çok kompleks bir konu. Buna sadece erkeklerin karar vermesi beklenemez oysa kadın olarak biz de bu masada varız diyoruz, 'She Leads' diyoruz" dedi. "Artık implementasyon zamanı" Limak Holding'in yeşil dönüşüm ve sürdürülebilirlik planlarına ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulunan Özdemir, şirketin çimento ve enerji başta olmak üzere farklı sektörlerde faaliyet gösterdiğini, enerji yatırımları arasında doğal gaz, termik, güneş ve hidroelektrik projelerinin bulunduğunu söyledi. COP31'in uygulama dönemine işaret ettiğini belirten Özdemir, "Şimdi görünen o COP31 diyor ki artık çok konuştuk, artık implementasyon zamanı. Yani biz bu aldığınız kararları yıllar boyunca artık uygulamamız gerekiyor" ifadelerini kullandı. Dünyada elektrifikasyonun hızlandığına dikkati çeken Özdemir, elektrikli araçların yanı sıra klima kullanımının da enerji talebini artıracağını kaydetti. Özdemir, ABD ve Japonya'da klima kullanım oranının yüzde 90 seviyesinde olduğunu, gelişmekte olan ülkelerde bu oranın yüzde 20-30 arasında değiştiğini, Nijerya'da ise yüzde 9 olduğunu belirterek, bu gelişmelerin elektrik talebinde önemli artışa neden olacağını ifade etti. Veri merkezleri ve yapay zekanın da enerji ihtiyacını artıran unsurlar arasında yer aldığını dile getiren Özdemir, su ihtiyacının da giderek daha önemli bir konu haline geldiğini söyledi. Özdemir, deniz suyunun arıtılarak kullanılabilir suya dönüştürülmesini sağlayan desalinasyon projelerinin yaygınlaştığını belirterek, bu tesislerin de ciddi miktarda enerjiye ihtiyaç duyduğunu vurguladı. Türkiye'de iki hidroelektrik yatırımı sürüyor Artan enerji ihtiyacının yeni yatırımları zorunlu kıldığını ifade eden Özdemir, Limak Holding'in Türkiye'de iki hidroelektrik baraj yatırımını sürdürdüğünü bildirdi. Avrupa'da güneş enerjisi yatırımlarını değerlendirdiklerini belirten Özdemir, Kuveyt'te gerçekleştirilecek 500 megavatlık güneş enerjisi yatırımı için başvuru yapan şirketlerden biri olduklarını kaydetti. Özdemir, "Yani bir tarafta hem yenilenebilir yatırımlarına devam ediyoruz, bir tarafta da Çimento gibi sektörlerde enerji ihtiyacımızı nasıl azaltabiliriz, karbon salınımımızı nasıl azaltabiliriz, ona çalışıyoruz." dedi. YEK-G ihalelerine katılmayı planlıyor Türkiye'nin yenilenebilir enerji yatırımlarına ilişkin planlarını da paylaşan Özdemir, yeni ihalelere katılmayı hedeflediklerini belirtti. Özdemir, "Biz yenilenebilir de aynen Türkiye'de yatırımlarımıza devam edeceğiz, yani bunun dışında ihaleye çıkacak olan YEKAK'lara gireceğiz." ifadelerini kullandı. Özellikle deniz üstü rüzgar enerjisi (offshore) yatırımlarına yabancı yatırımcıların da ilgi gösterdiğini aktaran Özdemir, bu alanda aktif rol almak istediklerini söyledi. Özdemir, "Yani bizi yenilenebilirde rüzgar olsun, güneş olsun, offshore rüzgar olsun göreceksiniz" dedi. Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanı'nın açıkladığı 2040 vizyonu kapsamında nükleer enerji ve küçük modüler reaktör (SMR) yatırımlarını da takip ettiklerini belirten Özdemir, Türkiye'nin enerji alanında dışa bağımlılığını azaltmasının önemine işaret etti. Özdemir, "Çünkü sadece enerji yatırımı dışa bağımlılık açısından da incelemek gerekiyor, yani Türkiye kendine yetebilir, 2040'ta kendine yetebilir bir enerji platformunu açıkladı Sayın Bakan ve burada da tabi nükleer santralin de yapılması, SMR'ların da yapılması gerekiyor, dolayısıyla biz enerjide aktif bir oyuncuyuz, bütün eee değişik yenilenebilirlerde yer almak istiyoruz." değerlendirmesinde bulundu. Enerji ekipmanlarının Türkiye'de üretilmesi için görüşmeler başladı Yenilenebilir enerji yatırımlarında kullanılan ekipmanların Türkiye'de üretilmesine yönelik çalışmalara da değinen Özdemir, bu konuda görüşmelere başladıklarını bildirdi. Özdemir, güneş panelleri ve deniz üstü rüzgar enerjisi projelerinde kullanılan ekipmanların Türkiye'de üretilmesinin sanayi açısından önemli olduğunu belirterek, "Biz de gerçekten 'made in Türkiye' yani Türkiye'nin kendi kendine aynı zamanda sanayide de yeterli olması gerektiğine çok inanıyoruz ve bu konuda da biliyorsunuz biz sanayide de çimento sektöründeyiz, o sebeple bu konularda aynı zamanda görüşmelerde bulunuyoruz, inşallah belirgin bir sonuca ulaşırız." dedi. Yeni otoyol özelleştirmelerinde yer almak istiyor Özdemir, Türkiye'de gündeme gelmesi beklenen otoyol ve altyapı özelleştirmelerine ilişkin de değerlendirmelerde bulundu. Limak Holding'in kamu-özel sektör işbirliği (PPP) modeli kapsamında uzun yıllardır otoyol projelerinde yer aldığını belirten Özdemir, Çanakkale Köprüsü ve Kınalı-Malkara Otoyolu'nun yanı sıra Antalya-Alanya Otoyolu projesinde de çalışmaların sürdüğünü ifade etti. Özdemir, "Biz ciddi olarak PPP'lerde yani kamu özel sektör işbirliklerinde yıllardır otoyol yaptık ve yapmaya devam edeceğiz, sonuçta otoyol özelleştirmelerinde de yer almak istiyoruz, bir takım yabancı yatırımcılar da bizimle görüşmelere geliyorlar, konjonktürü takip ediyoruz, ekiplerimiz ciddi olarak çalışıyorlar" diye konuştu.

news.title: İtalya'da 100'den fazla okula bomba ihbarı: Öğrenciler tahliye edildi
news.summary: İtalya genelinde 100'den fazla okula gönderilen anonim bomba tehdidi içeren e-posta paniğe neden oldu. Başkent Roma'da çok sayıda okul ve kreş tahliye edilirken, güvenlik ekipleri ihbar yapılan binalarda kontroller gerçekleştirdi.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: İtalya'da 100'den fazla okula bomba ihbarı: Öğrenciler tahliye edildi
news.summaryTr: İtalya genelinde 100'den fazla okula gönderilen anonim bomba tehdidi içeren e-posta paniğe neden oldu. Başkent Roma'da çok sayıda okul ve kreş tahliye edilirken, güvenlik ekipleri ihbar yapılan binalarda kontroller gerçekleştirdi.
news.articleText: İtalya'da 100'den fazla okula bomba ihbarı: Öğrenciler tahliye edildi - İtalya genelinde 100'den fazla okula gönderilen anonim bomba tehdidi içeren e-posta paniğe neden oldu. - Başkent Roma'da çok sayıda okul ve kreş tahliye edilirken, güvenlik ekipleri ihbar yapılan binalarda kontroller gerçekleştirdi. İtalya'da ülke genelinde 100'den fazla okula gönderilen bomba tehdidi içeren e-posta, güvenlik alarmına yol açtı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Anonim mesajın ardından çok sayıda okul tahliye edilirken, polis ekipleri ihbar yapılan binalarda inceleme başlattı. İtalyan Rainews24 kanalının haberine göre, "Mikhail Andropov" imzasıyla gönderilen e-postada bazı okullarda bomba bulunduğu öne sürüldü. Tehdidi alan okullarda güvenlik önlemleri kapsamında tahliye işlemleri gerçekleştirildi. Roma'da çok sayıda okul ve kreş boşaltıldı Bomba alarmı başkent Roma'da da etkili oldu. Kentte çok sayıda okulun tahliye edildiği, Appio-Tuscolano semtindeki okulların yanı sıra yakın çevredeki kreşlerin de boşaltıldığı bildirildi. İhbarın ulaştığı okullarda gerekli güvenlik kontrollerinin yapıldığı basına yansıdı. Muhalefetten İçişleri Bakanı'na çağrı İtalya'daki gelişmelere muhalefetten de tepki geldi. 5 Yıldız Hareketi (M5S) milletvekili Luca Pirondini, yaşananların ciddi bir alarm olduğunu belirterek İçişleri Bakanı Matteo Piantedosi'yi parlamentoya bilgi vermeye çağırdı. Ülkede son haftalarda da farklı güvenlik olayları yaşanmıştı. Süpermarketlerin buzdolaplarını hedef alan siber saldırılar ve uçaklara yönelik asılsız bomba ihbarları kamuoyunun gündemine gelmişti. İtalya'da son dönemde art arda yaşanan siber saldırılar ve asılsız bomba ihbarları, kamu kurumları ile ulaşım ve perakende sektöründeki güvenlik önlemlerini yeniden gündeme taşıdı.

news.title: Jeep'in kasım kampanyasında indirim 337 bin TL'ye ulaştı: İşte model model fiyatlar
news.summary: Jeep, kasım ayı kampanyası kapsamında Avenger ve Compass modellerinde özel fiyatlar sunuyor. Kampanyada en yüksek fiyat avantajı 337 bin lirayla Compass Summit versiyonunda sağlanırken, Avenger modellerinde indirim tutarı 100 bin liradan başlıyor.

news.titleTr: Jeep'in kasım kampanyasında indirim 337 bin TL'ye ulaştı: İşte model model fiyatlar
news.summaryTr: Jeep, kasım ayı kampanyası kapsamında Avenger ve Compass modellerinde özel fiyatlar sunuyor. Kampanyada en yüksek fiyat avantajı 337 bin lirayla Compass Summit versiyonunda sağlanırken, Avenger modellerinde indirim tutarı 100 bin liradan başlıyor.
news.articleText: Jeep'in kasım kampanyasında indirim 337 bin TL'ye ulaştı: İşte model model fiyatlar Jeep, kasım ayı kampanyası kapsamında Avenger ve Compass modellerinde özel fiyatlar sunuyor. Kampanyada en yüksek fiyat avantajı 337 bin lirayla Compass Summit versiyonunda sağlanırken, Avenger modellerinde indirim tutarı 100 bin liradan başlıyor. Jeep, kasım ayı kampanyaları kapsamında mevcut aracını yenilemek veya yeni bir SUV sahibi olmak isteyenlere özel fırsat sunuyor. Şirketten yapılan açıklamaya göre, kampanya kapsamında mevcut araçlarını Jeep yetkili satıcılarına getiren müşteriler, yeni Jeep Avenger ve Jeep Compass modellerinde sunulan özel fiyatlardan yararlanabiliyor. Joshua kahverengisi, iç döşemelerde kapı içlerinde, ön konsolda, konsol kapağında ve koltuk döşemelerinde kullanılıyor. news.title: İstanbul simidine coğrafi işaret: Zeytinburnu'ndaki fırın tescilli üretici oldu
news.summary: İstanbul Ticaret Borsası tarafından coğrafi işaret tescili alınan İstanbul simidinin üretim standartlarını karşılayan ilk işletme olan ve Zeytinburnu Belediyesi tarafından restore edilerek yeniden işlev kazandırılan Merkezefendi Tarihi Fırını'na, Coğrafi İşaret Tescil Belgesi verildi.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: İstanbul simidine coğrafi işaret: Zeytinburnu'ndaki fırın tescilli üretici oldu
news.summaryTr: İstanbul Ticaret Borsası tarafından coğrafi işaret tescili alınan İstanbul simidinin üretim standartlarını karşılayan ilk işletme olan ve Zeytinburnu Belediyesi tarafından restore edilerek yeniden işlev kazandırılan Merkezefendi Tarihi Fırını'na, Coğrafi İşaret Tescil Belgesi verildi.
news.articleText: İstanbul simidine coğrafi işaret: Zeytinburnu'ndaki fırın tescilli üretici oldu İstanbul Ticaret Borsası tarafından coğrafi işaret tescili alınan İstanbul simidinin üretim standartlarını karşılayan ilk işletme olan ve Zeytinburnu Belediyesi tarafından restore edilerek yeniden işlev kazandırılan Merkezefendi Tarihi Fırını'na, Coğrafi İşaret Tescil Belgesi verildi. İstanbul simidinin coğrafi işaret tescilinin ardından üretimde yeni bir aşamaya geçildi. Tescilli ürünün ilk kullanım hakkını kazanan işletme belli olurken, belge Zeytinburnu Belediye Başkanı Ömer Arısoy'a takdim edildi. Fırında düzenlenen törende konuşan İstanbul Valisi Davut Gül, İstanbul simidinin coğrafi işaret tescili için daha önce Türk Patent ve Marka Kurumuna başvuruda bulunulduğunu, yapılan değerlendirmeler sonucunda simidin üretim standartlarının yazılı hale getirildiğini anlattı. İl Tarım ve Orman Müdürlüğünün de desteğiyle belirlenen özelliklerin İstanbul'da üretilen simitlerde uygulandığını aktaran Gül, simidin nasıl, hangi undan yapıldığının, ne kadar pişirildiğinin, üzerinde ne kadar susam olacağının ve hangi koşullarda satılacağının nizami olarak belirlendiğini söyledi. Gül, sonraki aşamanın belirlenen standartlara uygun üretim yapan işletmelere coğrafi işaret kullanım hakkının verilmesi olduğunu ifade ederek, "İşte burada da Zeytinburnu Belediye Başkanımızı tebrik ediyoruz, teşekkür ediyoruz. Bu standartlarda Merkezefendi'de üretilen simitlerin olduğunu söyleyerek müracaat etti ve yapılan değerlendirmeler neticesinde İstanbul simidinin Türk Patent ve Marka Kurumunun belirlediği standartlarda üretildiğine şahitlik ederek bu belge takdim edilecek. Allah sayılarınızı arttırsın. İnşallah geçmişten günümüze gelen bu üretim zinciri, üretim tekniği sonsuza kadar da devam etmiş olacak." ifadelerini kullandı. İstanbul Ticaret Borsasını tebrik eden Gül, benzer ürünlerin coğrafi işaret tescili için de çalışmalar yürütüldüğünü aktararak, "İstanbul'a ait her bir ürün tescil edilecek. Bu coğrafi işaret, ürünlerin geçmişten geleceğe nakledilmesini sağlamış olacak." dedi. Zeytinburnu Belediye Başkanı Ömer Arısoy da Merkezefendi Tarihi Fırını'nın 19. yüzyılda inşa edildiğini, fırın olarak kullanımının sona ermesinin ardından farklı işlevler üstlendiğini ve bir dönem metruk halde kaldığını söyledi. Belediye olarak tarihi yapıyı restore ederek asli işlevine döndürdüklerini belirten Arısoy, fırının yeniden faaliyete geçmesinin ardından çıkan yangında yapının bir bölümünün zarar gördüğünü, bu kısmın da Koruma Kurulu kararları ve denetimi doğrultusunda aslına uygun şekilde yeniden inşa edildiğini anlattı. Arısoy, fırını sıradan bir ekmek üretim merkezi olarak tasarlamadıklarını, geleneksel ekmek üretimini yaygınlaştırmayı amaçladıklarını ifade ederek, "Ata tohumlarından üretilmiş buğdayla 130 yıllık ekşi mayayla hiçbir katkı maddesi kullanılmaksızın burada ekmek ve ekmek dışında simit dahil üretimler yapıyoruz." dedi. Tarihi fırının aynı zamanda özellikle ev hanımlarına geleneksel ekmek üretimi konusunda sertifikalı eğitimler verilen bir mekan olduğunu kaydeden Arısoy, İstanbul simidi üretimine de kuruluşundan itibaren büyük önem verdiklerini belirtti. İstanbul simidinin kentin geleneksel lezzetlerinden biri olduğunu dile getiren Arısoy, "Coğrafi işaret belgesiyle fırın için yeni bir dönem başladı. Bu hem sorumluluğumuzu artırıyor hem de burada emek veren arkadaşlarımız için büyük bir coşku, büyük bir gurur. Baştan itibaren olduğu gibi bundan sonra da bu coğrafi tescil belgesine sahip bir işletme olarak titiz bir biçimde bu üretimi sürdüreceğiz." ifadelerini kullandı. İstanbul Ticaret Borsası Başkanı Ali Kopuz ise İstanbul simidinin kentin kimliğine ve kültürüne katkı sunan, İstanbulluları ortak duyguda buluşturan simgesel değerlerden biri olduğunu ifade etti. Coğrafi işaretlerin bu mirası koruyarak geleceğe aktarmada önemli bir güvence oluşturduğunu belirten Kopuz, İstanbul Ticaret Borsası'nın tarihi belgeler ışığında yürüttüğü çalışmalarla simidin ayırt edici özelliklerini ve geleneksel üretim standartlarını belirlediğini kaydetti. Kopuz, çalışmaların Vali Gül'ün himaye ve desteğiyle İl Tarım ve Orman Müdürlüğü ile ilgili kurumların işbirliğinde yürütüldüğünü aktararak, "Böylece İstanbul'un asırlık mirasını resmi güvenceye kavuşturarak geleceğe emanet ettik." dedi. Zeytinburnu Belediyesinin coğrafi işaretli İstanbul simidinin ilk üreticisi olmak üzere başvuruda bulunduğunu aktaran Kopuz, Merkezefendi Tarihi Fırını'na İstanbul simidi coğrafi işaret kullanımına ilişkin ilk belgenin takdim edileceğini bildirdi. Etkinlikte ayrıca, İstanbul simidinin tarihine ilişkin sergi ziyaret edildi ve simidin tanıtım filmi gösterildi. Katılımcılar, İstanbul simidinin geleneksel yöntemlerle hazırlanışını ve üretim aşamalarını yerinde izledi. Programda, tarihi fırının geçmişteki işleyişini yansıtan canlandırmalar da gerçekleştirildi. Dönemin kıyafetlerini giyen katılımcıların fırından alışveriş yapması ve dönemin yetkililerinin fırında gerçekleştirdiği denetim temsili olarak canlandırıldı. Törene, Zeytinburnu Kaymakamı Adem Uslu, İstanbul İl Tarım ve Orman Müdürü Suat Parıldar, İstanbul Fırıncılar Odası Başkanı Erdoğan Çetin ve davetliler katıldı. Merkezefendi Tarihi Fırını, 19. yüzyılda Merkez Efendi Vakfiyesine bağlı olarak mahalleye ekmek üreten tarihi bir yapı olarak biliniyor. Yaklaşık 200 yıllık geçmişe sahip yapı, Zeytinburnu Belediyesi tarafından gerçekleştirilen restorasyon çalışmasıyla geleneksel işlevini sürdürmek üzere yeniden düzenlendi. Fırının yeniden faaliyete geçirilmesiyle sağlıklı ve nitelikli ekmek ile hamur işi üretiminin geleneksel yöntemlerle günümüzde de devam ettirilmesi amaçlandı.

news.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now
news.summary: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now
news.summaryTr: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.
news.articleText: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now - Published An effort to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of waging war on Iran without congressional authorisation, has failed on Capitol Hill. A majority of the House of Representatives voted to refer impeachment articles to a committee - essentially killing the effort introduced by dissident Republican congressman Thomas Massie of Kentucky, for now. In his first news briefing from the Pentagon in six months, Hegseth called the impeachment effort a "farce" and "sabotage". The bid to find the cabinet secretary guilty of misconduct and ultimately remove him from office was seen as a long shot as it could have required a number of other Republicans to defy President Donald Trump. However, that calculation could change in January when the Democratic Party assumes control of both chambers of Congress, following its successes in the US midterm elections. For now, Trump's Republican Party remains in control. After Tuesday's vote, the most senior Democrat in the House, Hakeem Jeffries, said: "This is not the end of it. It's just the beginning." The question on which lawmakers were voting on Tuesday was whether or not to refer the resolution to the House Judiciary Committee, which is led by Republicans. The alternative would have been to allow the resolution to proceed in the House itself. All Republicans other than Massie voted to refer the resolution to the committee, meaning that the congressman's effort failed in a 211-204 vote. The move to send the measure to the panel effectively kills the effort, as there is only a short period of time left in this Congress. More than a dozen members missed the ballot. They included 11 Democrats, several of whom blamed traffic issues for their absences. Several members of the party criticised their fellow lawmakers for missing the vote. "You should show up and do your job," said Democratic Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed during an interview with CNN, making a direct address to those who did not vote. The Michigan lawmaker recently won a US Senate race in Michigan, having criticised US ties to Israel and the war in Iran on the campaign trail. - Analysis: Hegseth fights for his political life with appeal to Trump - Published19 hours ago Meanwhile Trump celebrated Tuesday's outcome in a post on Truth Social, saying the effort "has miserably FAILED". "Again, Victories in Venezuela and Iran, the Best Recruitment Numbers in the History of the Military (Long waiting lists to get in!), and Spirit like rarely seen before, led to the EXONERATION of a Great American Patriot," Trump said, referring to Hegseth. After the vote, Massie said he "wasn't surprised" but "was disappointed", according to BBC's US media partner CBS. "My diagnosis of Congress is these people know what to do," he added. "They just can't bring themselves to do it, even when it would benefit them politically." Massie had previously acknowledged his impeachment bid may not succeed immediately, but argued it could help push Trump to replace Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process. The Kentucky congressman also said that removing Hegseth now would give the Senate time to approve a replacement while Republicans were still in power. Impeachment resolutions can be carried past the end of a congressional term, meaning Democrats would be able to take it up next year. The Democrats will take control of both chambers of Congress in January following a successful midterm election that allowed them control of both chambers. House Speaker Mike Johnson, a Republican, had predicted earlier in the day that the impeachment bid would fail. In the eight articles of impeachment formally introduced in the House on Monday, Massie said Hegseth was "breaking the law and must be held accountable" for fighting a war in Iran for more than 90 days without lawmakers' approval. The impeachment articles also accused Hegseth of overseeing "extrajudicial killings" in the US campaign against boats alleged to be carrying drugs in the Pacific Ocean and Caribbean Sea. At a news conference on Tuesday, Hegseth called efforts to impeach him a political stunt by a Trump administration opponent who was "disgruntled and defeated". Hegseth also argued Massie's resolution endangered national security, because it communicated to US adversaries "that the United States will actually punish its own warriors and its own civilian leadership for successfully executing lawful military operations". "This is not patriotism. This is sabotage," he said. He echoed some statements Trump had made during a surprise appearance at the White House briefing room on Monday, including touting a rise in military recruitment levels. But Hegseth said Massie was motivated by policy differences and "not high crimes, not misdemeanours, not treason, not bribery, not the kinds of offences the founders intended when they wrote the impeachment clause". Massie, who lost re-election earlier this year to a Trump-backed opponent, has been critical of Trump and the war in Iran since it began in February. He had already incurred the president's ire for demanding the Trump administration release files on deceased sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. While Hegseth has survived politically for now, many lawmakers - including some Republicans - have questioned how long he can last in the administration. news.articleTextTr: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now - Published An effort to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of waging war on Iran without congressional authorisation, has failed on Capitol Hill. A majority of the House of Representatives voted to refer impeachment articles to a committee - essentially killing the effort introduced by dissident Republican congressman Thomas Massie of Kentucky, for now. In his first news briefing from the Pentagon in six months, Hegseth called the impeachment effort a "farce" and "sabotage". The bid to find the cabinet secretary guilty of misconduct and ultimately remove him from office was seen as a long shot as it could have required a number of other Republicans to defy President Donald Trump. However, that calculation could change in January when the Democratic Party assumes control of both chambers of Congress, following its successes in the US midterm elections. For now, Trump's Republican Party remains in control. After Tuesday's vote, the most senior Democrat in the House, Hakeem Jeffries, said: "This is not the end of it. It's just the beginning." The question on which lawmakers were voting on Tuesday was whether or not to refer the resolution to the House Judiciary Committee, which is led by Republicans. The alternative would have been to allow the resolution to proceed in the House itself. All Republicans other than Massie voted to refer the resolution to the committee, meaning that the congressman's effort failed in a 211-204 vote. The move to send the measure to the panel effectively kills the effort, as there is only a short period of time left in this Congress. More than a dozen members missed the ballot. They included 11 Democrats, several of whom blamed traffic issues for their absences. Several members of the party criticised their fellow lawmakers for missing the vote. "You should show up and do your job," said Democratic Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed during an interview with CNN, making a direct address to those who did not vote. The Michigan lawmaker recently won a US Senate race in Michigan, having criticised US ties to Israel and the war in Iran on the campaign trail. - Analysis: Hegseth fights for his political life with appeal to Trump - Published19 hours ago Meanwhile Trump celebrated Tuesday's outcome in a post on Truth Social, saying the effort "has miserably FAILED". "Again, Victories in Venezuela and Iran, the Best Recruitment Numbers in the History of the Military (Long waiting lists to get in!), and Spirit like rarely seen before, led to the EXONERATION of a Great American Patriot," Trump said, referring to Hegseth. After the vote, Massie said he "wasn't surprised" but "was disappointed", according to BBC's US media partner CBS. "My diagnosis of Congress is these people know what to do," he added. "They just can't bring themselves to do it, even when it would benefit them politically." Massie had previously acknowledged his impeachment bid may not succeed immediately, but argued it could help push Trump to replace Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process. The Kentucky congressman also said that removing Hegseth now would give the Senate time to approve a replacement while Republicans were still in power. Impeachment resolutions can be carried past the end of a congressional term, meaning Democrats would be able to take it up next year. The Democrats will take control of both chambers of Congress in January following a successful midterm election that allowed them control of both chambers. House Speaker Mike Johnson, a Republican, had predicted earlier in the day that the impeachment bid would fail. In the eight articles of impeachment formally introduced in the House on Monday, Massie said Hegseth was "breaking the law and must be held accountable" for fighting a war in Iran for more than 90 days without lawmakers' approval. The impeachment articles also accused Hegseth of overseeing "extrajudicial killings" in the US campaign against boats alleged to be carrying drugs in the Pacific Ocean and Caribbean Sea. At a news conference on Tuesday, Hegseth called efforts to impeach him a political stunt by a Trump administration opponent who was "disgruntled and defeated". Hegseth also argued Massie's resolution endangered national security, because it communicated to US adversaries "that the United States will actually punish its own warriors and its own civilian leadership for successfully executing lawful military operations". "This is not patriotism. This is sabotage," he said. He echoed some statements Trump had made during a surprise appearance at the White House briefing room on Monday, including touting a rise in military recruitment levels. But Hegseth said Massie was motivated by policy differences and "not high crimes, not misdemeanours, not treason, not bribery, not the kinds of offences the founders intended when they wrote the impeachment clause". Massie, who lost re-election earlier this year to a Trump-backed opponent, has been critical of Trump and the war in Iran since it began in February. He had already incurred the president's ire for demanding the Trump administration release files on deceased sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. While Hegseth has survived politically for now, many lawmakers - including some Republicans - have questioned how long he can last in the administration. İstanbul Valiliği, kentte beklenen kuvvetli rüzgar ve fırtına nedeniyle vatandaşları uyardı. Meteoroloji Genel Müdürlüğü'nün son değerlendirmelerine dayandırılan açıklamada, rüzgarın yarın öğle saatlerinden itibaren etkisini artıracağı bildirildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Bugün güney ve güneybatı yönlerden orta kuvvette, zaman zaman kuvvetli esen rüzgarın yarın saatte 40-60 kilometre hıza ulaşması bekleniyor. Rüzgarın zaman zaman saatte 60-70 kilometre hızla fırtına şeklinde eseceği tahmin ediliyor. Cuma günü fırtınanın hızı 90 kilometreye çıkacak Valiliğin açıklamasına göre, cuma günü sabah saatlerinden itibaren rüzgarın şiddetini daha da artırması bekleniyor. Fırtına ve kısa süreli kuvvetli fırtına şeklinde esecek rüzgarın hızının saatte 60-90 kilometreye ulaşabileceği öngörülüyor. Kuvvetli rüzgar ve fırtınanın cumartesi akşam saatlerinden itibaren etkisini kaybetmesi bekleniyor. Valilikten vatandaşlara uyarı İstanbul Valiliği, fırtınayla birlikte yaşanabilecek olumsuzluklara karşı dikkatli ve tedbirli olunması çağrısında bulundu. Açıklamada, ulaşımda aksamalar, çatı uçması, ağaç ve direklerin devrilmesi gibi risklere karşı vatandaşların önlem alması gerektiği vurgulandı.

news.title: Transport workers in Chile block highways in protest over surging fuel prices
news.summary: Hundreds of bus and lorry drivers are blocking traffic along major highway routes across the country.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Transport workers in Chile block highways in protest over surging fuel prices
news.summaryTr: Hundreds of bus and lorry drivers are blocking traffic along major highway routes across the country.
news.articleText: Transport workers in Chile block highways in protest over surging fuel prices - Published Hundreds of transport workers in Chile have blocked roads and highways across the country in protest over high fuel prices. Drivers of busses and lorries began protesting on Tuesday, gathering in convoys to halt traffic along major routes. They are demanding a relief from surging diesel prices, which have been driven up by the war in Iran. Talks between government officials and protest leaders have so far failed to reach a resolution, with another meeting expected to take place on Wednesday. The protest is being organised by the Fuerza del Norte trade union, which represents around 80% of Chile's lorry drivers, and the No+TAG civic protest movement. "There is no point of agreement with the government that could offer any perspective to find solutions for everyone," Andrés Alarcón, a spokesman for No+TAG, said after talks broke down on Tuesday, adding "the strike continues". Economy Minister Daniel Mas called for further dialogue, but warned "at some point, we will have to clear the highways". He stressed the protests were impacting economic activity and exports, saying "we need to get the country moving again". The government of President José Antonio Kast has faced public discontent over fuel prices for months. The average price of diesel has risen 74% since March, according to industry groups. Juan Cornejo, the president of the Association of Intercity Bus Owners, which represents 14 mid-sized companies, told AFP that "we've reached our limit". "We've spent more than a month working with negative numbers," he added. Lorry driver Claudio Elguezabal, who took part in a protest near the capital, Santiago, on Tuesday morning, said the situation was unsustainable. "Right now I'm not making any profit. Sometimes you even have to put in your own money to cover the client," AFP quoted the 47-year-old as saying.

news.summary: The expansion adds more than 200 tokenized UK and EU equities, including all 40 companies in Germany’s DAX index, as xStocks plans further expansion into Hong Kong.

news.titleTr: Kraken parent adds over 200 tokenized UK and EU stocks to xStocks
news.summaryTr: The expansion adds more than 200 tokenized UK and EU equities, including all 40 companies in Germany’s DAX index, as xStocks plans further expansion into Hong Kong.
news.articleText: Kraken parent adds over 200 tokenized UK and EU stocks to xStocks The expansion adds more than 200 tokenized UK and EU equities, including all 40 companies in Germany’s DAX index, as xStocks plans further expansion into Hong Kong. Kraken parent Payward’s xStocks platform added tokenized versions of more than 200 stocks listed in the United Kingdom and European Union. Payward said Wednesday that eligible users can trade the new tokens on Kraken and participating xStocks Alliance platforms. The tokens remain unavailable to investors in the UK. The expansion includes tokenized shares of all 40 companies in Germany’s benchmark DAX index, including SAP, Siemens, Allianz and Deutsche Telekom. According to a separate Wednesday announcement from Deutsche Börse, the tokens are available for trading on its affiliated 360X platform, with 24/7 trading supported on select venues. Payward said the latest expansion brings xStocks’ offering to more than 1,500 tokenized assets. The company reported more than $45 billion in cumulative transaction volume and over 550,000 unique holders. According to Payward, the new tokens are backed one-to-one by shares held with a regulated custodian. Kraken’s risk disclosure says xStocks tokens give holders exposure to the shares’ performance without voting rights or legal claims to the underlying stock. Token Terminal data put xStocks’ market capitalization at $1.1 billion, about 22% of the $4.9 billion in tokenized stocks the firm tracks. xStocks ranked third, behind Binance bStocks at $1.5 billion and Ondo Finance at $1.4 billion. Payward said it plans to add hundreds of Hong Kong-listed equities in the coming weeks. Related: Kraken launches xChange engine to power tokenized stock trading

news.title: Eswatini gives illegal foreign businesses 12 months to leave
news.summary: The law follows the growth of foreign-owned businesses in retail sector in rural areas.

news.titleTr: Eswatini gives illegal foreign businesses 12 months to leave
news.summaryTr: The law follows the growth of foreign-owned businesses in retail sector in rural areas.
news.articleText: Eswatini gives illegal foreign businesses 12 months to leave - Published Businesses owned by Asian nationals are being closed across Eswatini as the government cracks down on foreign-owned enterprises. The crackdown follows Parliament's approval of the Citizen Economic Empowerment Act, which seeks to increase ownership and participation by emaSwati, as citizens in the kingdom are known. The legislation follows complaints from local traders that foreign-owned businesses are encroaching on traditional retail markets, increasing competition and threatening livelihoods. South Africa has witnessed more severe enforcement actions, including raids, arrests and the disruption of foreign-run informal businesses, while Kenya has also stepped up action against foreign traders. Its implementation has sparked a heated debate in Parliament, with MPs divided over how quickly foreign businesses owners should be required to leave. Mbabane East MP Welcome Dlamini told Parliament on Tuesday that officials from the trade ministry had already begun enforcing the law by closing Asian-owned shops. Hhohho Regional MP Tanele Magagula called for immediate action, saying "Businesses owned by foreigners in the rural areas must be seized immediately." But Dlamini questioned whether local entrepreneurs were ready to take over the businesses, arguing that foreigner should be given time tio train their successors. "Why can't we give the Asians or foreigners at least three years before 'kicking them' out so that emaSwati can learn to run the businesses?" he asked. Magagula rejected the suggestion, questioning why struggling local traders should have to wait while struggling economically. "Why must we wait for three years while emaSwati suffer?" she asked. Parliament subsequently agreed that foreign business owners should be given at least 12 months to leave. However, unless the law is formally amended to reflect that timeline, the ministry could continue enforcing its provisions. The closures follow inspections launched by the trade ministry in August. Some businesses inspected in areas such as Mbabane were found to be fully compliant. However, the inspections also raised concerns about working conditions an administrative practices at foreign-owned enterprises, including complaints by employees over days off, annual leave and overtime. At least one case remains under investigation. Eswatini, a small landlocked kingdom in Southern Africa, faces significant economic hardship, with about 70% of its population living below the poverty line. The government says the new law is intended to expand economic opportunities for citizens, amid concerns that poverty and hunger could fuel further political unrest. The crackdown comes mid growing pressure on foreign-owned businesses elsewhere in the region, particularly in neighbouring South Africa, where anti-immigration campaigns have led to raids, arrests,looting and the disruption of foreign-run informal businesses. On July 30, 2026, the March and March movement intensified its campaign against undocumented immigrants, giving them a deadline to leave. Another protest followed on September 30. The campaigns have been accompanied by violence and attacks on foreign owned businesses. Two Ghanaian and two Nigerian nationals reported killed amid the tensions. Kenya has also stepped up enforcement against foreign traders, bring renewed attention to the treatment of foreign nationals and their businesses across the region. news.summary: Bitcoin fell to an 11-week low of $72,670 after slipping below short-term holders’ average cost basis of about $75,700, according to CryptoQuant.

news.titleTr: Bitcoin short-term holders send 47K BTC to exchanges at a loss
news.summaryTr: Bitcoin fell to an 11-week low of $72,670 after slipping below short-term holders’ average cost basis of about $75,700, according to CryptoQuant.
news.articleText: Bitcoin short-term holders send 47K BTC to exchanges at a loss Bitcoin fell to an 11-week low of $72,670 after slipping below short-term holders’ average cost basis of about $75,700, according to CryptoQuant. Bitcoin (BTC) short-term holders sent more than 47,000 BTC to exchanges on Tuesday as Bitcoin fell to an 11-week low, with the coins worth less than their purchase price. Key points: - Short-term holders moved 47,025 BTC to exchanges while the coins were worth less than their acquisition price. - The 24-hour total was the third-highest since July, according to CryptoQuant. - CryptoQuant’s Julio Moreno said a sustained break below $73,000 and a failed rebound above that level would strengthen the case that Bitcoin’s broader downtrend was continuing. Short-term holders’ underwater exchange inflows rank third since July Data from onchain analytics platform CryptoQuant showed short-term holders sent 47,025 BTC carrying unrealized losses to exchanges in the 24 hours to midnight UTC at the start of Wednesday. The tally was among the largest 24-hour totals in the four months of data tracked by CryptoQuant and came as Bitcoin dropped to $72,670, its lowest level since Aug. 20. The short-term holder metric tracks Bitcoin held for up to 155 days. Short-term holders are generally considered more likely to sell when prices fall, even at a loss. “On November 10, profitable transfers stood near 1,700 BTC, meaning approximately 27 BTC arrived at a loss for every 1 BTC transferred at a profit,” CryptoQuant said. The largest 24-hour inflows of BTC carrying unrealized losses since late July occurred on Oct. 8, hours after Bitcoin fell back to $80,000. Rolling 24-hour inflows peaked at 50,500 BTC. Short-term holders’ exchange inflows of BTC carrying unrealized losses. Source: CryptoQuant CryptoQuant analyst flags $73,000 as Bitcoin tests August lows Cointelegraph previously reported that short-term holders’ average cost basis was around $75,700. Related: Stock ETF buyers pounce on dip as Bitcoin funds bleed $1.6 billion Short-term holders moved into an aggregate unrealized profit on Aug. 20 as Bitcoin rebounded toward $80,000. They slipped back into an aggregate unrealized loss on Friday. STH cost basis vs. BTC/USD. Source: CryptoQuant CryptoQuant head of research Julio Moreno said Bitcoin could still be in the downtrend that began in November 2025. “If rallies keep stalling near the cohort’s cost basis and net unrealized losses deepen, the August rebound starts to look like a pause in the broader downtrend,” he wrote on Monday. “A sustained break below $73,000 followed by a failed retest from below would strengthen the case for bear-market continuation.” STH-NUPL vs. BTC/USD. Source: CryptoQuant CryptoQuant’s net unrealized profit/loss (NUPL) metric showed that short-term holders reached their highest level of unrealized profitability since November 2025 as Bitcoin climbed to $87,200 in September.

Key points: - Short-term holders moved 47,025 BTC to exchanges while the coins were worth less than their acquisition price. - The 24-hour total was the third-highest since July, according to CryptoQuant. - CryptoQuant’s Julio Moreno said a sustained break below $73,000 and a failed rebound above that level would strengthen the case that Bitcoin’s broader downtrend was continuing. Short-term holders’ underwater exchange inflows rank third since July Data from onchain analytics platform CryptoQuant showed short-term holders sent 47,025 BTC carrying unrealized losses to exchanges in the 24 hours to midnight UTC at the start of Wednesday. The tally was among the largest 24-hour totals in the four months of data tracked by CryptoQuant and came as Bitcoin dropped to $72,670, its lowest level since Aug. 20. The short-term holder metric tracks Bitcoin held for up to 155 days. Short-term holders are generally considered more likely to sell when prices fall, even at a loss. “On November 10, profitable transfers stood near 1,700 BTC, meaning approximately 27 BTC arrived at a loss for every 1 BTC transferred at a profit,” CryptoQuant said. The largest 24-hour inflows of BTC carrying unrealized losses since late July occurred on Oct. 8, hours after Bitcoin fell back to $80,000. Rolling 24-hour inflows peaked at 50,500 BTC. Short-term holders’ exchange inflows of BTC carrying unrealized losses. Source: CryptoQuant CryptoQuant analyst flags $73,000 as Bitcoin tests August lows Cointelegraph previously reported that short-term holders’ average cost basis was around $75,700. Related: Stock ETF buyers pounce on dip as Bitcoin funds bleed $1.6 billion Short-term holders moved into an aggregate unrealized profit on Aug. 20 as Bitcoin rebounded toward $80,000. They slipped back into an aggregate unrealized loss on Friday. STH cost basis vs. BTC/USD. Source: CryptoQuant CryptoQuant head of research Julio Moreno said Bitcoin could still be in the downtrend that began in November 2025. “If rallies keep stalling near the cohort’s cost basis and net unrealized losses deepen, the August rebound starts to look like a pause in the broader downtrend,” he wrote on Monday. “A sustained break below $73,000 followed by a failed retest from below would strengthen the case for bear-market continuation.” STH-NUPL vs. BTC/USD. Source: CryptoQuant CryptoQuant’s net unrealized profit/loss (NUPL) metric showed that short-term holders reached their highest level of unrealized profitability since November 2025 as Bitcoin climbed to $87,200 in September.

news.summary: The BBC understands the discount chain, which has been edging towards administration, will be given more time to find a buyer.

news.titleTr: Poundland set for more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue
news.summaryTr: The BBC understands the discount chain, which has been edging towards administration, will be given more time to find a buyer.
news.articleText: Poundland set for more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue - Published Poundland and its 11,000 employees are hopeful that the retailer's impending collapse can be delayed to allow time for a last-minute rescue deal. The discount chain has been edging towards administration after being blocked by its owners from accessing cash in its bank accounts. A deadline to secure a buyer for the business is set to expire at midnight, but sources close to the situation have told the BBC that they expect more time will be given, thanks to the release of £10m in funding. A committee of MPs is set to question Gordon Brothers, Poundland's US owners, on Wednesday following accusations that the investment firm hopes to profit from selling off Poundland's 600 stores and stock piecemeal. Gordon Brothers - which bought the chain for just £1 last year - is accused of forcing that outcome by restricting Poundland's access to available cash needed to restock stores and pay wages and rent, ahead of the crucial Christmas trading period. The investment firm has denied the claims. But pressure remains on Poundland's owners after a takeover bid was rejected. The decision prompted calls for answers from politicians, including Prime Minister Andy Burnham. About £50m had been frozen by Gordon Brothers, the BBC understands, meaning Poundland bosses were unable to restock shelves across its 600 shops. However, sources close to the matter told the BBC on Tuesday that a release of £10m by its owners, while "small in the scale of things" could help at least postpone the chain's collapse while a longer term solution was explored. Views on Poundland performance differ The 10-day moratorium to protect Poundland from its creditors expires on Thursday, but if there is a prospect of a solvent deal, the deadline could be extended. Views on the chain's performance differ between those running operations and the owners. Poundland boss Barry Williams told staff last week that like-for-like sales, which exclude new store openings, were up 11.4%. The sales period included Halloween, but Williams said this was £1.5m ahead of budget. He added the business made a profit of £18.1m in the year to September, which was a "strong recovery" from the previous year where there were losses of £68m. However, Gordon Brothers has painted a different picture, saying the chain remains "challenged and vulnerable to any potential downturn in future trading". There has been interest from the likes of Poundstretcher, Tesco and B&M in picking up Poundland stores which could mean continuing employment for workers in the event the chain is broken up and sold off in chunks. The main issue is whether a piecemeal sale would protect more jobs than a buyer willing to keep Poundland as a national chain. Get in touch Are you affected by issues discussed in this story? news.title: Bitget Wallet reports sevenfold jump in crypto phishing risk alerts
news.summary: The wallet flagged about 37,000 signing requests a week for phishing in Q3 and said better monitoring likely contributed to the increase.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Bitget Wallet reports sevenfold jump in crypto phishing risk alerts
news.summaryTr: The wallet flagged about 37,000 signing requests a week for phishing in Q3 and said better monitoring likely contributed to the increase.
news.articleText: Bitget Wallet reports sevenfold jump in crypto phishing risk alerts The wallet flagged about 37,000 signing requests a week for phishing in Q3 and said better monitoring likely contributed to the increase. Crypto wallet provider Bitget Wallet said Wednesday it was expanding AI-assisted threat detection after its weekly average of signing requests flagged for potential phishing rose 7.4-fold in the third quarter of 2026. The wallet flagged about 37,000 such requests per week in Q3, up from 5,000 in Q2, according to Bitget Wallet chief operating officer Alvin Kan. “The increase likely reflects both greater threat activity and improved detection capabilities, although the data does not allow us to quantify each factor’s contribution,” Kan told Cointelegraph. The wallet introduced AI-assisted risk detection in Q2, he added. Kan said that the tally counted flagged signing interactions, not unique attacks or confirmed financial losses. Bitget Wallet said its expanded AI checks examine website code and domain registration details for signs of fraud. The wallet also simulates transactions to spot hidden permissions before users sign. Bitget Wallet also said AI helped identify 90% of newly blocked risky domains in October, compared with 36% in Q2. Nearly 70% of domains its AI flagged that month had no matching alerts in the external threat feeds it checked. The findings come amid continued phishing threats targeting crypto users. In July, a trader lost nearly $1 million after signing a malicious Ethereum token approval. An August investigation by Rapid7 uncovered a phishing campaign that targeted 885,000 phone numbers and directed recipients to websites impersonating crypto wallet providers. news.title: Tearful Smith switches allegiance to Netherlands
news.summary: Tatjana Smith, South Africa's most decorated Olympian, switches allegiance to the Netherlands.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Tearful Smith switches allegiance to Netherlands
news.summaryTr: Tatjana Smith, South Africa's most decorated Olympian, switches allegiance to the Netherlands.
news.articleText: Tearful Smith switches allegiance to Netherlands - Published South Africa's most decorated Olympian Tatjana Smith was in tears as she announced that she has switched allegiance to the Netherlands. The 29-year-old won four Olympic breaststroke medals, including two golds, before retiring after the Paris 2024 Games. She came out of retirement in September and hopes to compete in the 50m breaststroke as the event makes its Olympic debut at the 2028 Games in Los Angeles. Smith, whose maiden name was Schoenmaker, wiped away tears as she read a letter addressed to South Africa, saying that "dreams can change as we grow". Smith has dual citizenship because her father is Dutch. She said she has "always been Dutch and South African" and that this is an opportunity to "explore another part of my identity and heritage that I've never experienced through sport". She said it also offers her "greater high-performance support and the potential to build a more sustainable career" because the "financial and practical challenges of swimming were among the reasons my previous career became difficult to sustain". Smith has previously said that financial worries, which included a dispute with Swimming South Africa over prize money, contributed to her decision to step away from the sport. Swimming South Africa has been approached for comment. Smith won four world and Commonwealth gold medals between 2018 and 2023. She won gold in the 200m breaststroke and 100m silver at the Tokyo Olympics in 2021, before adding 100m gold and 200m silver in 2024. "Representing South Africa was a childhood dream come true, and it's a chapter I will always look back on with immense pride and gratitude," she said on social media., external "The people, the memories and everything we achieved together will always be part of me. But dreams can change as we grow. "This next chapter is about embracing another part of who I am, falling in love with the journey and discovering what more I'm capable of. "I'm excited for what lies ahead, and I truly hope you'll continue to be part of the journey with me." Smith, who said she will continue to live and train in South Africa, is set to represent the Netherlands for the first time at the short course World Championships from 1-6 December. She acknowledged that her switch "may disappoint or break the hearts" of some supporters. The Ministry of Sport, Arts and Culture in South Africa said it was aware of the "problems at Swimming South Africa". "The country was delighted to see her return to the pool, but South Africa does not own her," a statement read. "Tatjana's choice belongs to her and it should not be turned into a political weapon." Gayton McKenzie, Minister of Sports, Arts and Culture, said: "Every medal, every record and every anthem she gave us belongs to our history forever. We now have to share her with the Netherlands."

news.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

According to the letter, a derivatives clearing organization may use a trust company for daily settlements if it treats the trust company as it would a settlement bank under applicable CFTC requirements. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

news.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

Ancak söz konusu tutar vadesinde ödenemedi. Dünya Varlık Yönetim, aynı tahvil için mayıs ayında 11,5 milyon TL, ağustos ayında ise 11,7 milyon TL tutarında kupon ödemesi gerçekleştirmişti. items.articleText: Fon soruşturması: 3 ismin sevk yazısında 2,4 milyar liralık kazanç ve 500 bin dolarlık rüşvet iddiası - Fon soruşturmasında tutuklanan Ali Paslı, Yunus Arıncı ve Ömer Murat Gülkan hakkındaki savcılık sevk yazısında dikkat çeken tespitler yer aldı. Yazıda 2,4 milyar liralık fon kazancı, 500 bin dolarlık rüşvet ve 3,8 milyar liralık VDMK işlemlerine ilişkin iddialar aktarıldı. Sermaye piyasalarında gerçekleştirilen işlemlere ilişkin yürütülen fon soruşturması devam ediyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Soruşturma kapsamında tutuklanan Ali Paslı, Yunus Arıncı ve Ömer Murat Gülkan hakkındaki savcılığın sevk yazısında şüphelilere dair tespitler yer aldı. İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığınca, sermaye piyasalarında gerçekleştirilen işlemlere ilişkin fon soruşturması devam ediyor. Adil Katılım Bankası'nın 2,4 milyar liralık fon kazancı mercek altında Soruşturma kapsamında tutuklanan OMG Capital Advisors Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Ömer Murat Gülkan, eski Takasbank Genel Müdürü Yunus Arıncı ile Adil Katılım Bankası ortaklarından Ali Paslı hakkında savcılığın tutuklama talebinde bulunduğu sevk yazısına ulaşıldı. Yazıda, Ali Paslı'nın kurucularından ve pay sahiplerinden olduğu Adil Katılım Bankasının 31 Temmuz 2025'te şirket sermayesinden 1 milyar 844 milyon lira tutarında TLY fonu satın aldığı kaydedildi. Aynı fonların 23 Ekim 2025'te satıldığı ve toplamda yaklaşık 2 milyar 430 milyon lira kar elde edildiği aktarılan yazıda, kuruluş aşamasındaki bir bankanın sermayesinin yarısından fazlasını, TEFAS'ta yeni işlem görmeye başlamış ve geçmiş performansı bulunmayan tek bir fona yatırmasının risk yoğunlaşması ve likidite yönetimi bakımından izah edilemez nitelikte olduğu vurgulandı. Yazıda, yaklaşık 2 aylık süreçte bu denli yüksek kar elde edilmesinin hayatın olağan akışına uygun olmadığı belirtilerek, elde edilen getirinin, aynı dönemde piyasa koşullarıyla uyumsuz olduğu dile getirildi. Dosyaya 6 Kasım'da gelen MASAK raporuna göre, bankanın Tera fonlarına yatırdığı paranın yine Tera Yatırım Bankası AŞ tarafından Ali Emre Ballı'nın (aracında ölü bulunan Finansal Kurumlar Birliği Başkanı) bağlantılı şirketlerine verilen kredilerle sağlandığının anlaşıldığı ifade edildi. Yunus Arıncı hakkındaki 500 bin dolarlık rüşvet aldığı iddiası Yazıda, Takasbank'ın eski genel müdürü olan şüpheli Yunus Arıncı'nın bu görevi sırasında Tera Yatırım temsilcileri Erdin Özel ve Emir Münir Sarpyener ile irtibat halinde bulunduğu belirtilerek, şüphelinin Umut Güner (Dünya Gazetesi'nin ortaklarından) aracılığıyla 500 bin dolar rüşvet aldığına dair ifade bulunduğu aktarıldı. Ayrıca Güner'den 4 milyon 500 bin lira alan Arıncı'nın görevinin sağladığı gücü kötüye kullanarak bu miktarı iade etmediğine dair kuvvetli suç şüphesi bulunduğu vurgulandı. Yazıda, bunlara ek olarak, Tera grubunun Katılımevim'i devralması sürecinde Yunus Arıncı'nın BDDK'nin yönlendirmesiyle kredi artışı yaptığına dair beyan bulunduğu ifade edilerek, toplanan deliller birlikte değerlendirildiğinde, şüphelinin üzerine atılı suçu işlediği yönünde kuvvetli suç şüphesini gösteren somut deliller olduğu kaydedildi. Şüpheli Ömer Murat Gülkan'ın ise OMG Yönetim ve Danışmanlık AŞ'nin yüzde 65 ortağı ve imza yetkilisi olduğu anlatılan yazıda, Sermaye Piyasası Kurulundan (SPK) herhangi bir izni bulunmayan şirketi aracılığıyla, yazılı sözleşme olmaksızın Türkiye Sigorta, Türkiye Hayat ve BES fonundan şirket hesabına para alarak 2022-2026 döneminde toplam 3,8 milyar lira tutarında VDMK işlemi gerçekleştirdiği belirtildi. Yazıda 2,4 milyar liralık fon kazancı, 500 bin dolarlık rüşvet ve 3,8 milyar liralık VDMK işlemlerine ilişkin iddialar aktarıldı. Sermaye piyasalarında gerçekleştirilen işlemlere ilişkin yürütülen fon soruşturması devam ediyor. İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığınca, sermaye piyasalarında gerçekleştirilen işlemlere ilişkin fon soruşturması devam ediyor. items.articleText: SpaceX'ten Almanya'ya dev güneş enerjisi siparişi: Hedef 100 GW üretim - Elon Musk'ın uzay şirketi SpaceX, uydularında kullanılacak güneş hücrelerinin üretimi için Alman Singulus Technologies ile anlaşma yaptı. - 2027'nin ilk yarısında teslim edilmesi planlanan üretim hattının, şirketin 100 GW'lık üretim hedefini desteklemesi bekleniyor. Elon Musk'ın sahibi olduğu SpaceX, uzay tabanlı güneş enerjisi üretimini büyütmek için Almanya merkezli Singulus Technologies ile tedarik anlaşması imzaladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Anlaşma kapsamında Singulus, SpaceX'e heteroeklem (HJT) güneş hücrelerinin üretiminde kullanılacak anahtar teslim bir üretim hattı sağlayacak. Şirketler arasındaki stratejik ortaklığın yalnızca bu hatla sınırlı kalmayacağı, ilerleyen dönemde birden fazla ek üretim hattının da teslim edilmesinin planlandığı belirtildi. Üretim hattı 2027'nin ilk yarısında teslim edilecek Singulus Technologies, üretim hattını 2027'nin ilk yarısında teslim edecek. Üretimin aşamalı olarak artırılması ve SpaceX'in 100 GW'ın üzerindeki üretim ekipmanı hedefine destek verilmesi planlanıyor. SpaceX'in Teksas'ın Bastrop kentindeki tesisinde Starmind uydularının üretimini hızlandırdığı belirtiliyor. Yeni anlaşma, şirketin uydu üretim kapasitesini artırma planları kapsamında önem taşıyor. Singulus Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi Lars Lieberwirth, şirketin ıslak kimya, vakum kaplama ve termal işlem teknolojilerini bir araya getiren üretim yaklaşımının sektörde farklılaşmalarını sağladığını söyledi. Lieberwirth, SpaceX ile ortaklığın bu teknolojilerin büyük ölçekte sanayileştirilmesine katkı sunacağını ifade etti. Musk'ın güneş enerjisi yatırımları büyüyor SpaceX ile yapılan anlaşma, Musk'ın güneş enerjisi üretimine yönelik yatırımlarının gündemde olduğu bir dönemde geldi. Reuters, daha önce Tesla'nın Çinli üreticilerden yaklaşık 3 milyar dolarlık güneş enerjisi üretim ekipmanı satın almak üzere görüşmeler yürüttüğünü bildirmişti. Bu süreçte Singulus ile SpaceX, Mart 2026'da stratejik ortaklığa gitmiş ve Alman şirkete önemli miktarda finansman sağlanmıştı. Geçen ay ise Singulus'a teminatlı ve ikincil nitelikte yeni bir kredi desteği sunulmuştu. Teksas Denetçisi'ne sunulan başvuru belgelerine göre Tesla, 100 GW kapasiteli ve üretimin tüm aşamalarını kapsayan güneş enerjisi projesine 10,1 milyar dolar yatırım yapmayı hedefliyor. PV-Tech'in haberine göre projede ticari üretimin 2029'un ilk çeyreğinde başlaması öngörülüyor. Uydularda HJT güneş hücrelerine ilgi artıyor Uzay uygulamalarında güneş hücresi teknolojileri de dönüşüm geçiriyor. Uydularda bugün ağırlıklı olarak kullanılan galyum arsenit hücreler yüksek performans sunarken, maliyetleri silikon tabanlı alternatiflere kıyasla oldukça yüksek. SpaceX ve Amazon gibi şirketlerin uydu sayısını artırması, daha düşük maliyetli silikon tabanlı güneş hücrelerine yönelik ilgiyi yükseltiyor. Sektörde, önümüzdeki beş yıl içinde alçak Dünya yörüngesindeki uydularda silikon teknolojisinin yaygınlaşabileceği ve HJT hücrelerin öne çıkabileceği değerlendiriliyor. SpaceX'in Starlink bölümünden Sorumlu Kıdemli Başkan Yardımcısı Mike Nicolls da Singulus ortaklığının Teksas'taki Starmind uydu tesisinde yüksek performanslı güneş hücresi üretimi için yeni bir yol açacağını belirtti. HJT (heteroeklem) teknolojisi, farklı silikon katmanlarını bir araya getirerek güneş hücrelerinin verimliliğini artırmayı hedefliyor. Teknoloji, yüksek performans ve üretim maliyetlerini dengeleme potansiyeli nedeniyle uzay uygulamalarında da ilgi görüyor.
